name: gizza-ai/regex-codemod
summary: Run a regex find-and-replace across a pasted multi-file bundle and preview the diff

tool.description: Apply one regex (or literal) find-and-replace across a pasted multi-file bundle and preview the result. Files are split at header markers (=== path ===, --- path ---, ==> path <==, # file: path, a custom marker_regex, or none for a single file) and each file is rewritten independently. Replacements support $1/${name} capture references, and the i/m/s flags, whole-word matching and first-match-only are all available. Returns a git-apply-able unified diff (default), the fully rewritten bundle, or a JSON report with per-file replacement counts.

context.description: Unchanged context lines shown around each hunk in the unified diff. Default 3.

dot_matches_newline.description: Let `.` also match newlines, so a pattern can span lines (the regex `s` flag). Default false.

file_marker.description: How file boundaries are detected in the bundle: auto (any of the four below), equals (=== path ===), dashes (--- path ---), arrow (==> path <==), comment (# file: path or // file: path), custom (use marker_regex), or none (treat the whole input as one file). Default auto.

ignore_case.description: Match case-insensitively (the regex `i` flag). Default false.

include_unchanged.description: Also report files the pattern did not change — as "# unchanged: path" comment lines in diff output, or as entries in json output. Default false.

literal.description: Match `pattern` as plain text instead of a regular expression, and insert `replacement` verbatim. Default false.

marker_regex.description: Custom file-marker pattern, matched against each line, with one capture group for the path, e.g. ^@@@ (\S+)$. Only used when file_marker=custom.

multiline.description: Make ^ and $ match at the start and end of every line (the regex `m` flag). Default false.

output.description: What to return: diff (a git-apply-able unified diff of the changes), full (the whole rewritten bundle) or json (a per-file report with counts and diffs). Default diff.

pattern.description: The regular expression to find (Rust regex syntax, e.g. \boldName\b). With literal=true it is matched as plain text instead.

replace_all.description: Replace every match (the regex `g` flag). When false, only the first match in each file is replaced. Default true.

replacement.description: Replacement text. $1/${name} insert capture groups; $$ is a literal dollar. With literal=true it is inserted verbatim. Default empty, which deletes each match.

text.description: The pasted bundle: one or more files concatenated behind header markers, e.g. "=== src/a.js ===" followed by that file's contents.

whole_word.description: Require a word boundary on both sides of the match, so "id" does not match inside "idx". Default false.
